name: brand_kit_add_asset
description: Store an SVG (logo, icon, illustration) or a self-contained HTML component (button, badge, card) in a brand kit's assets, kept editable instead of as a picture. @see guides_get('brand-kit')

asset_kind.description: The role. HTML is always "component". For an SVG pick logo, icon or pattern; defaults to "other".

html.description: A complete, self-contained HTML document for ONE component: inline <style>, fonts and images as data: URIs. Scripts and any external URL are removed, so a component that depends on them arrives broken. Pass exactly one of svg or html.

name.description: Shown in the kit, e.g. "Primary button". Defaults to "Vector" or "Component".

slot.description: Optional Assets group to file it in (brand_kit_get section_slots.assets). "library" keeps it for designs only and never feeds generation. Omit to leave it unfiled (grouped by its kind). Ignored for a logo.

svg.description: SVG markup. Text should be converted to paths: a layout engine draws shapes, not live SVG text. Pass exactly one of svg or html.
